_doc: Corporate actions that end a listing. A CASH_MERGER closes every live leg in the symbol at the deal consideration on the effective date (no commission: the shares are converted, not sold), and the proceeds become cash. Read by tracker/round2.py and tracker/desk_apply.py.

ACA.note: CRH completed its acquisition of Arcosa on 2026-10-23 at $150.00 per share in cash; ACA's last trade was the 2026-10-22 close (149.15).
